name: Dokuzetsu Akuma to Muttsuri Tenshi to no Yojouhan Kurashi
original_name: 毒舌悪魔とムッツリ天使との四畳半暮らし
source:
You are Tominaga Yahiko, a dead-end salaryman in the planning department of a travel agency. All of your tour plans have been rejected recently, and every time your superior bullies and power harasses you. You come home exhausted every night, and the stress has even caused erectile dysfunction.

But one night, something changes. As usual, you return to your rundown apartment and crawl into bed to sleep. You wake up in the middle of the night to find an astonishingly beautiful girl leaning her face close to your crotch.

"You've got a pretty good thing going on down here ♪"

Red eyes that seem to suck you in. Black horns growing out of her head. And most of all, a pair of magnificently large breasts. As you are stunned by the strange beauty in front of you, the mysterious girl — a self-proclaimed demon — reaches her tongue towards your member.

And then, with her demonic technique, you are cured of your erectile dysfunction and, in a fit of pleasure, come for the first time in a long time. Unlike you, however, the demon seems dissatisfied.

"Your dick should be capable of much more than this. I'm going to draw it out from you!"

With this unilateral declaration, the demon girl starts living with you. The demon's target is the high-quality magical power contained in your semen. She plans to use it to revive the sealed Maou.

During such days of being drained by the demon, a female angel appears before you. Turns out that the angel is actually the superior who was bullying you.

"Rather than letting the demon take your magical power, I'll milk your semen myself!"

The angel tries to prevent the demon from retrieving the magical power contained in your semen by milking it first. And so the battle for your magical semen, which is necessary for the Maou's resurrection, begins.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.waffle1999.com/game/102yojouhan/#story]official website[/url]]
translation:
你是富永弥彦，旅行社企划部的一名没出路的上班族。最近你所有的旅行计划都被拒绝了，每次你的上级欺负和权力都骚扰你。你每天晚上回到家都精疲力尽，压力甚至导致勃起功能障碍。

但有一天晚上，事情发生了变化。像往常一样，你回到破旧的公寓，爬上床睡觉。你半夜醒来，发现一个美丽得惊人的女孩把脸靠在你的胯部。

“这里发生了一件非常好的事情♪”

红色的眼睛似乎要把你吸进去。黑色的角从她的头上长出来。最重要的是，有一对极其巨大的乳房。当你被眼前奇异的美丽惊呆时，神秘的女孩——自称恶魔——向你的成员伸出了舌头。

然后，通过她的恶魔技术，你的勃起功能障碍被治愈了，并且在一阵愉悦中，很长一段时间以来第一次勃起。然而，与你不同的是，恶魔似乎并不满足。

“你的鸡鸡应该不止这些。我要把它从你身上拔出来！”

有了这单方面的声明，魔女就开始和你一起生活了。恶魔的目标是你的精液中蕴含的优质魔力。她打算用它来复活被封印的魔王。

在被恶魔榨干的日子里，一位女性天使出现在你的面前。原来，天使其实就是欺负你的上级。

“与其让恶魔夺走你的魔力，不如我亲自榨取你的精液！”

天使试图通过先挤奶来阻止恶魔取回你的精液中所蕴含的魔力。魔王复活所必需的魔法精液的争夺战就这样开始了。
